caseNameFull: Elizabeth C. Taft v. Erank K. Bowers, Collector and Gilbert C. Greenway, Jr. v. Frank K. Bowers, Collector
attorneys: Mr. Henry W. Taft for petitioner in No. 554. Mr. Roger S. Baldwin for petitioner in No. 575. Solicitor General Mitchell, Assistant Attorney General Wille-brandt and Mr. Sewall Key. for respondent.

opinions.text: Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit granted. The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of the petitions for writs of certiorari in these cases.
